The '''Department of Defense''', or '''Defense Department''', was the branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government that was created during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to oversee all aspects of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. This included the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], as well as all other organizations charged with operating, or related to, military support services.
